blurb: The La Riviere Centennial Park is located on the West side of La Riviere. There is 18 well treed- serviced sites. Electrical and water hook up, 15 and 30 amp serviced sites. Very clean and modern washroom facilities with showers included, which are wheelchair accessible. Each site has a fire pit and picnic table. Campers are required to supply their own fire wood. There is a playground and large recreation area.
